song.title: Since Jesus Came Into My Heart
song.lyrics:
[V1] There is a fountain filled with blood Drawn from Immanuel's veins And sinners, plunged beneath that flood Lose all their guilty stains
[C1] Since Jesus came into my heart Since Jesus came into my heart Floods of joy o'er my soul Like the sea billows roll Since Jesus came into my heart
[V2] There's a sweet apprehension A holy reverent fear That I should be forgiven And that He would be near
[C2] Since Jesus came into my heart Since Jesus came into my heart Floods of joy o'er my soul Like the sea billows roll Since Jesus came into my heart
[V3] I have heard the song of angels In sweet harmonious tone But since Jesus came into my heart All is different now, alone
[C3] Since Jesus came into my heart Since Jesus came into my heart Floods of joy o'er my soul Like the sea billows roll Since Jesus came into my heart
